testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: Verify branch is rebased on base (needs pull-request context and full git history, not the worktree); Validate renovate.json (fetches renovate from the npm registry via npx on every run); smoke-omp (needs bun and a globally installed pinned omp binary); install-and-smoke (needs bun and a globally installed pinned omp binary).

cwdAudit.line: CWD-AUDIT: dirty /Users/chris/dev/fleet-plugin — M docs/metrics/tier-outcomes.tsv; ?? docs/metrics/runs/2026-11-11T172901Z/{closeout.json,ledger.md,phase0.json,plugin-version}. I ran only `pwd` and read-only commands there, so these are not mine (another member's close-out output).

survived.claim: SKILL.md End of run step 2 still says the tick prints `run over` 'once the run is draining with no open PR and no live implementer', which this diff falsifies under no-merge; the same sentence in references/close-out.md was updated and SKILL.md's was not.
survived.evidence: sed -n 192,198p SKILL.md shows line 195-196 unchanged. close-out.md:19-22 now adds 'Under `no-merge` a PR carrying `ready-to-merge` holds nothing, unless it conflicts'. The diff's fleet-tick.mjs main() now computes `over` from `holding` (prs minus labelled, non-conflicting PRs) when merging is off. The PR body says SKILL.md was paid for by trimming other text, and the diff does touch SKILL.md elsewhere.
survived.suggested_fix: Add 'or, under `no-merge`, only `ready-to-merge` PRs open' to SKILL.md:196, or point to references/close-out.md, trimming elsewhere to stay under the 75,000-byte ceiling.

votes.reason: Read snapshot: SKILL.md:194-196 says run over prints 'once the run is draining with no open PR and no live implementer' with no no-merge qualifier. close-out.md:19-23 has the same sentence plus an added 'Under `no-merge` a PR carrying `ready-to-merge` holds nothing, unless it conflicts' sentence. The claim is accurate in substance. The close-out.md base sentence itself was not reworded; a qualifier was appended. No test was run; this is a prose-presence check. CWD-AUDIT: not run, nothing written in /Users/chris/dev/fleet-plugin

unverified.claim: close-out.md's drain paragraph (and SKILL.md:194) says the drain 'keeps the review, fix-applier and merge rows firing until the open PRs merge'; under no-merge the merge-bot row never fires (IDLE (merging off)) and the run ends with ready-to-merge PRs still open.
unverified.evidence: Lines 10-11 of close-out.md are untouched by the diff. The diff makes mergeBot() return `IDLE (merging off)` before any dispatch, and `over` ignores labelled PRs. SKILL.md:194 'Act on the review, fix-applier and merge rows' has the same issue.
unverified.suggested_fix: Qualify with 'merge row (merge-mode runs)' or 'until the open PRs merge or, under no-merge, reach ready-to-merge'.

unverified.claim: The mergingOf docstring says 'only `true` reads as on: a bot dispatched on a value nobody can read is the failure the switch exists to prevent', but an unreadable receipt (state 'unreadable') returns MERGE_DEFAULT = true, i.e. on.
unverified.evidence: mergingOf at lines 182-185: `if (read.state !== "ok" || read.receipt.merge === undefined) return MERGE_DEFAULT;`. readRunReceipt (lines 46-73) yields state 'unreadable' for non-JSON or invalid receipts. PR body point 3 limits the claim to a non-boolean `merge` field. The tick's phase0 gate presumably holds dispatching rows on an unreadable receipt, but I did not verify that.
unverified.suggested_fix: State that missing and unreadable receipts read as the default (on) and that the phase-0 gate, not mergingOf, holds dispatch then; or return false for 'unreadable'.

unverified.claim: The prStates header comment says `tracked` PRs are 'asked only in a run whose merge bot is off', but main() passes them only when `apply && !merging` (readOpts.trackMerged).
unverified.evidence: Diff: `const readOpts = { trackMerged: apply && !merging };` and `trackMerged ? run.prTracked : []`. The PR body says correctly 'only under --apply with merging off'.
unverified.suggested_fix: Say 'asked only under --apply in a run whose merge bot is off'.
